newsitem.title: NORWAY: Unocal/Statoil in Gulf of Thailand hydrocarbon fin.
newsitem.headline: Unocal/Statoil in Gulf of Thailand hydrocarbon fin.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Thursday U.S. oil company Unocal Corp had found hydrocarbons in the A area of block B10/32 in the Gulf of Thailand.
Unocal and Statoil, which is operator of the B and C areas, each have 45 percent in the acreage. Mitsui Oil Exploration holds the remaining 10 percent.
"Great optimism is reported by Unocal after the discovery, which lies in a gas-rich area only 12 kilometres west of the company's producing Erawan gas field," Statoil's Status Weekly newsletter said.
Statoil said further evaluation of the exploration well was planned, along with more seismic surveys and drilling over a three-year period to establish whether production will be profitable.
